name: preview_capture
description: Dry run of a new capture, a repeat from history (history_capture_id) or a save of existing recordings (recording_handles, optional before). Validates and resolves the plan without arming sensors, reserving capacity or reading application evidence, stores nothing and returns plan_digest; it is not permission. Submit the same request with request_capture and expected_plan_digest. Repeating a saved-recording entry preselects the same policy actions on current sources or returns NoCurrentSource with the recordings link.

cluster.description: Cluster name as configured in the hub (ADR-335 D4).

requested_retention_seconds.description: Requested evidence-access lifetime in seconds. Omission uses the administrator default; effective access and managed deletion remain bounded by current retention policy and its deletion budget. History restoration preserves its original request; use a normal edited preview to change it.

history_selection.description: Explicit manual selection when repeating a policy triggeringPod occurrence; the preview selects a current eligible Pod under the original workload identity.

recipients.description: No count limit: recipients are bounded only by the request body byte limit (memory) (maintainer rule: limits need a reason).

items.description: Current MCP tool names; raw operations use the grant vocabulary. get_extract views are further limited by the selected data classes.

version.description: Optional; omitted, the hub resolves the current version and records it.

d8.description: Peer generations are bounded only by the compiled program limit (BPF_MAXINSNS 4096).

d9.description: No length cap on the text; the bound is the compiled classic BPF program, which must fit the kernel limit BPF_MAXINSNS (4096 instructions), checked at compile, and the enclosing Kubernetes object size.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

d12.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

maxProcesses.description: The default batch covers every resolved main process of the Pod, sidecars included; the batch is bounded by maxProcesses × maxBytesPerProcess ≤ the action maxBytes and by maxTotalStop.

maxBytesPerProcess.description: Bounded only by the action and capture byte budget.

d22.description: Reviewed observation rate; the shipped default is derived from measured per-node collector event throughput. With the ring, it bounds every trace; there is no lifetime event total (ADR-335 D6).

notAfter.description: Optional; defaults to the access end (AccessUntil) of the collected evidence, capped by the administrator maximum. No deadline restarts when an artifact arrives.

d23.description: Result access covers every OAuth client and browser session of the same human; clients carry the user's own evidence access (maintainer decision).

plan_digest.description: Digest of the resolved plan: immutable target UIDs, dependencies and the normalized request. Submit it as request_capture expected_plan_digest.

pod_selection.description: Selection for the fixed pod-status/v1 preset. This describes the reviewed pod, never ongoing monitoring coverage or authority to select a replacement.

result_access_actions.description: Advisory follow-up access choices for this exact reviewed raw plan. Current authority, retained source and selected operations are checked again on submission. Absence grants no access.

version.description: Optional; omitted, the hub resolves the current version and records it.

d7.description: Peer generations are bounded only by the compiled program limit (BPF_MAXINSNS 4096).

d8.description: No length cap on the text; the bound is the compiled classic BPF program, which must fit the kernel limit BPF_MAXINSNS (4096 instructions), checked at compile, and the enclosing Kubernetes object size.

segments.description: Segment count; segment size is maxBytes ÷ segments. At least 2 so the ring can rotate; evicting one segment drops 1/segments of history.

d11.description: In-memory ring; a saved window copies at most maxBytes. The collector memory formula (specs/packets.md REQ-NET-003) bounds all rings on a node.

maxProcesses.description: The default batch covers every resolved main process of the Pod, sidecars included; the batch is bounded by maxProcesses × maxBytesPerProcess ≤ the action maxBytes and by maxTotalStop.

maxBytesPerProcess.description: Bounded only by the action and capture byte budget.

d21.description: Reviewed observation rate; the shipped default is derived from measured per-node collector event throughput. With the ring, it bounds every trace; there is no lifetime event total (ADR-335 D6).

d22.description: Pinned resolved profile. A builtin definition is embedded in the release binary (ADR-243) and is identified by its definition digest alone; organization and namespace definitions name their source cluster, namespace and object.

anchorRule.description: submissionPreparation measures every newly accepted manual capture from preparation of its first admitted submission: waiting counts and accepted retries retain the original registration. firstAcquisitionOrEarlierSource is reserved for typed existing-source snapshots and measures from the original source acquisition or an earlier retained source, never preview creation.

recording_handle.description: For an existing-source save, identifies the selected source row whose incremental snapshot assessment this is. It conveys no acquisition authority.

subject.description: OIDC Core: sub is at most 255 ASCII characters.

notAfter.description: Absent for an envelope without a lifetime ceiling (ADR-335 D6).

recording_handle.description: Opaque, principal-bound handle for preview_capture(recording_handles) and watch_live(action=open, source_handles).

capture_id.description: Manual-session source: the capture that owns it.

live_projections.description: Live projections watch_live can open on this source; empty when live viewing is unavailable.

blockers.description: Actionable blocker codes, for example NotSaveEnabled, LiveViewDisabled or SourceStopped.

hard_end.description: Source hard end; watches and saves end by then.

plan_digest.description: Digest of the resolved recording-save/v1 plan. Submit it as request_capture expected_plan_digest with the same preview request and an idempotency key.

blockers.description: Blocker codes; NoCurrentSource when a repeated save finds no matching running source (follow navigation_uri to list_recordings).
